Hi Tara — great to meet earlier. Thanks for walking through Acme's latency and cost objectives. Per our discussion I attached two items: the customer-facing pricing deck (acme-pricing-deck-v2.pdf) and the estimate workbook (redwood-estimate-ACME-0423.xlsx). Quick highlights from the estimate: 
- Baseline throughput target: 100 tokens/sec across peak window
- Monthly forecast (prod start month): ~$18k (with caching/batching suggestions applied)
- Optional dedicated pool and 99.9% SLO add-on: +$6k/mo

If helpful, I can run through the deck and the workbook in a 30-minute screen share to show how the numbers map to your traffic patterns and where we can trade latency for cost. Proposed windows (PDT):
- Mon Apr 12, 10:00–10:30
- Mon Apr 12, 14:00–14:30
- Tue Apr 13, 09:30–10:00

Or send over two times that work for you and I’ll send a calendar invite. Also: could you confirm whether the procurement/contact for security packaging is the same person cc’d (Acme IT)? If not, let me know who to add.

Attachments: acme-pricing-deck-v2.pdf (pdf), redwood-estimate-ACME-0423.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks —
Soojin Lee

If yes, I can walk through the workbook and call out where we applied prefix caching and the dedicated pool delta so your procurement and engineering partners can see the tradeoffs.
